reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: מארז מושלם של מסכות פנים, יש בפנים הרבה נוזל, אז המסכות לא מתייבשות, למרות שזה כבר פתוח אצלי חודש שלם והשתמשתי רק בשליש מהאריזה. בסופר פארם מוכרים את זה בהרבה יותר יקר, אז חבל לא להזמין. ממליצה
reviews.zh: 一盒完美嘅面膜，入面有好多精華液，所以面膜唔會乾，雖然已經開咗成一個月，我只用咗三份之一。Super-Pharm賣呢款嘢貴好多，所以唔訂真係可惜。推薦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: The SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask is a soothing sheet mask designed to hydrate and repair the skin barrier while calming irritation. Formulated with ingredients like D-panthenol, beta-sitosterol, and ceramides, it helps reduce redness, strengthen the skin’s moisture barrier, and deliver long-lasting hydration. The lightweight essence absorbs easily into the skin, leaving it soft, refreshed, and comfortable without feeling sticky. With 30 masks in one container, it’s a convenient daily treatment for keeping dry or sensitive skin balanced, plump, and healthy-looking.
reviews.zh: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 係一款舒緩嘅片裝面膜，設計用嚟保濕同修護皮膚屏障，同時鎮靜刺激。配方含有 D-panthenol、beta-sitosterol 同 ceramide 等成分，有助減少泛紅、強化皮膚嘅保濕屏障，並提供持久保濕。輕盈嘅精華好易俾皮膚吸收，用完之後皮膚變得柔軟、清爽、舒適，冇黏笠嘅感覺。一盒有30片，係一個方便嘅日常護理，可以保持乾性或者敏感肌平衡、飽滿同健康嘅狀態。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text:
The SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask gives your skin a reliable lift in hydration and barrier repair. The sheet is ultra-soft and fits really well, while the essence combines soothing ingredients like D-panthenol and beta-sitosterol with moisture-boosters like hyaluronic acid and ceramide. Several users report reduced redness after just one use and a noticeably calmer, plump complexion. ￼
It rinses down to a non-sticky finish, which is such a comfort on sensitive or reactive skin.
On the flip side, if your skin is very dry or desperate for a “corrective” treatment (versus maintenance), this might feel a little light — you may still need a richer cream afterwards.
reviews.zh:
SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 可以為皮膚提供可靠嘅保濕同屏障修護。面膜紙超柔軟，貼合度好好，而精華結合咗 D-panthenol 同 beta-sitosterol 等舒緩成分，再加 hyaluronic acid 同 ceramide 等保濕成分。有幾個用家話用一次之後泛紅減少咗，膚色明顯變得平靜同飽滿。
沖洗之後唔會黏笠，對於敏感肌或者容易反應嘅皮膚嚟講真係好舒服。
另一方面，如果皮膚好乾或者需要『修護型』嘅護理（多過日常保養），呢款可能會覺得稍為唔夠——之後可能仲要用返比較滋潤嘅面霜。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: The SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask is a strong daily maintenance mask that keeps the skin barrier happy. The sheet feels plush and the essence sinks in quickly, leaving skin soft, plump, and visibly soothed. On evenings when I’ve been on screens or under harsh lighting, this mask helped reduce redness and restore comfort. The finish is non-sticky and appropriate even for calmer nights.
reviews.zh: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 係一款強效嘅日常保養面膜，可以keep住皮膚屏障健康。面膜紙感覺好厚實，精華好快就俾皮膚吸收，用完之後皮膚變得柔軟、飽滿，明顯得到舒緩。當我夜晚對住螢幕或者處於強光之下，呢款面膜有助減少泛紅同恢復舒適感。妝效唔黏笠，就連皮膚較平靜嘅夜晚用都好啱。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text:
I’ve previously bought the some by mi daily sheet masks from Korea last time I visited and I loved it it has 30 mask in the whole box one of my box I’ve been using over 3 month and it’s still hold the moisture in the box and face masks even though it’s been open for a long time 
I’ve been amazed by it and I needed a safe option for pregnant people so I decided to try this panthenol repair daily mask as I am struggling with dry skin recently so I’m looking forward to try it.
reviews.zh:
我上次去韓國嘅時候買過 some by mi 嘅日常片裝面膜，我好鍾意，一整盒有30片，我其中一盒用咗超過3個月，盒入面同面膜仲keep住有水分，雖然已經開咗好耐。
我對佢好驚喜，而我又需要一款孕婦都安全嘅產品，所以決定試吓呢款 panthenol repair daily mask，因為我最近皮膚好乾，所以好期待試吓。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: The masks have a good size and have a well amount of toner, they're very moisturizing and gentle, leaves my skin radiant. The presentation is very convenient l but the container could totally improve because i needed to put something over it to keep it closed 🥺💋
reviews.zh: 面膜尺寸啱用，入面有充足嘅toner，好保濕又溫和，用完之後皮膚有光澤。包裝好方便，但個容器真係可以改善，因為我要喺上面放啲嘢先可以keep住佢封實 🥺💋

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: A really interesting mask. It’s moisturising but the effect doesn’t last long. It dries up quite quickly compared to other brands. Therefore, I have to replenish my skin after each mask use.
reviews.zh: 一款好有趣嘅面膜。有保濕但效果唔持久。相比其他品牌，乾得好快。所以我每次用完之後都要再保濕。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Beta Panthenol Repair Daily Mask 30 Sheets
reviews.text: 100% value! Sheet is a nice material that allows the essence to absorb and fit my face perfectly! The essence is super moisturizing and calming, but not greasy!
reviews.zh: 100% 抵！面膜紙質地好好，可以令精華吸收同貼合面形！精華超保濕同舒緩，但唔油笠！
